sections.title: Context
sections.body: Head of Product at SignAssist, a PropTech SaaS startup for real estate agents. Early growth stage, team of ~6, Dutch and European market.

sections.title: Problem
sections.body: Agents were managing the full rental lifecycle — listing, tenant screening, viewings, contracts, portfolio tracking — across disconnected tools. The business problem was poor unit economics: CAC/LTV was running at 162%, retention was too low to sustain growth, and revenue was not scaling with user acquisition.

sections.title: My role
sections.body: I owned the product entirely. I set the strategy, defined and prioritised the roadmap, led design and cross-functional delivery, and built the analytics infrastructure from scratch. I also managed investor relationships throughout. Engineering and design execution were delegated; all product decisions were mine.

sections.title: Approach
sections.body: Funnel analysis and prototype testing identified onboarding friction as the primary retention driver. I redesigned the onboarding and in-product messaging flows, testing iteratively before shipping. In parallel, I led development of an AI module that parsed contracts and legal documents into structured data with compliance flags — removing a significant manual step for agents. I also ran a pricing strategy exercise grounded in usage data and customer segmentation, and set up a recurring analytics review cadence to keep the team aligned on KPIs and growth levers.

sections.title: Outcome
sections.body:
• Active users grew 87% through improved onboarding and messaging
  • Time to value reduced 75% through iterative pre-launch testing
  • CAC/LTV improved from 162% to 21%
  • MRR grew 23% following the new pricing strategy
